title.narrative: Through UNICEF’s EPI programme, millions of target beneficiaries (mainly children under the age of one year, women of childbearing age, and individuals above the age of 18 years), gained access to quality immunization services to obtain protection against Vaccine Preventable Diseases (VPD), including COVID-19. This was achieved through several activities to improve the enabling environment, generate demand, and improve service delivery. These include the deployment of additional vaccinators, provision of motorbikes and cold chain equipment and facilities, and support towards strengthening primary health care services at facility and community levels through capacity building, integration, and improving coordination.
